full_details: The light was up before four. Field's Holinshed stayed shut at the side of the board, because the chronicle only says the thing was done. You had to say how. Westminster Hall, the cousin in the chair's shadow, the King sent for to give it up with his own mouth. The crown sat in two hands like a well with two buckets. Then the unmaking, item by item. Then the glass, sent for, looked in, and broken. Three sheets, and seven hours, and you did not walk once. At eleven Alse came up. Mistress Ansell had feared you were dead. You sent word that you were well. You were not in the Shrew, and you did not go. The Rose bill was a title on the table. At night the cat sat on the sheets.
one_sentence: You stayed in and wrote the unmaking across three sheets.
title: Three sheets on the deposition
